notes.title: Demo Quality of Life Changes
notes.notes:
Hello!

As the main game has continued to grow and improved, I felt it necessary to bring the demo up to speed to better reflect what the full game is like. As such, i've moved the following features from the main game to the demo:

[list]
[*] Improved Movement
[*] Controller Support
[*] Physics tweaks
[*] UI fade when in front of player
[*] Various bug fixes
[/list]

Happy Climbing!
